sources.name: HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags), reported by Push Square
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
1. Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops. [1][5]
2. No online play, DLC or extra playthrough is needed — one single-player run covers the whole list. [1]
3. The longest step is A Long Road (100% completion); plan on around 200 hours in total. [1][2]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
1. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 — it is Jason's first mission. [1][5]
2. The trophy pops when the mission ends; story trophies cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. [1][5]
2. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play; nothing extra is needed. [1]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 2. The trophy pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. [1][5]
2. Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 3. The trophy pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. [1][5]
2. Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 4. The trophy pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'. [1][5]
2. Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.note: PowerPyx's table lists the final mission under Chapter 4 ('Starting From Zero') — the same mission it lists for the Chapter 4 trophy — while the five-chapter structure in other guides places the finale in Chapter 5. [1][6]
trophies.guide:
1. Complete the final mission of the story, the last mission of Chapter 5. [5][6]
2. Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
1. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. [1][5]
2. Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
1. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. [1][5]
2. Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
1. Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. [1][5]
2. Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
1. Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. [1][5]
2. Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
1. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. [1][5]
2. Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
1. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. [1][5]
2. Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
1. Finish the story first: the 100% checklist only appears after the credits, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts. [1][2]
2. Work through the checklist. It is closer to 60% true completion: most items ask for a share, not everything — for example 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditation spots and 100 of 125 flamingos. [1][2][3]
3. The items that demand everything are the robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 8 bank vaults), 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. [1][2]
4. Nothing on the checklist is missable; everything can still be done in free-roam after the story. [1][2]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
1. Perform any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. The four kinds are 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them freely. [1][2]
2. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. [1]
3. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. [1]
4. The 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you want A Long Road. [1][2]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
1. Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. [1][4]
2. Check what you have done under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; the tracker counts 9 types. [1]
3. Most types turn up on their own while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist. [1]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
1. Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across 12 range locations. [1][2][4]
2. The gold medals are not very difficult; use the ranges as you find them and clean up the rest after the story. [1]
3. All 42 golds are also required for the 100% checklist. [2]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
1. Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total. [1][2][4]
2. Every location counts; there is no shortcut around a location you skip. [1]
3. All 42 races are required for the 100% checklist, so this trophy arrives with A Long Road. [2]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
1. Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations in total. [1]
2. Any mix of race types counts; pick the easiest ones first. [1]
3. The 100% checklist asks for 30 of the 40 unique races won, plus 10 of 13 race-challenge gold medals. [2]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
1. After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui' (meet Cal), wait for Cal's text message. [1]
2. It marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento — go there and beat Cal in the fishing challenge. [1]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
1. Play one of the 4 arcade games ('Video Games' in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind at the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. [1]
2. To 'complete' a game, finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge. [1]
3. The home games are available from Chapter 1 (briefly unavailable during some story sections, but still doable after the story). [1]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide:
1. Play as Lucia in Chapter 3: Andy's questline is marked automatically, starting with a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. [1]
2. Complete all 5 Andy quests: 'Climbing the Cellerichain' (parts 1-3), 'Pay the Cellerica Fee', 'Peach!', 'Read the Label' and 'Puff Puff Pass'. [1]
3. The quests stay available after the story. [1]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide:
1. Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, after the mission 'Island Dreams'. He calls you, then appears as a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. [1]
2. Dive for his treasures: he marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map; dig them up with the metal detector and bring them back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his sets. [1]
3. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up). Track him under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. [1]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
1. Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. [1]
2. Complete all 5 Billy quests: 'Thrillbillies', 'Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab', 'Mall Rats', 'The Impaler' and 'Hometown Heroes'. [1]
3. The quests stay available after the story. [1]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. [1]
2. Confirmed strands that count: Kirk (Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile deliveries), plus more strangers still being found. [1]
3. The strands stay available after the story in free-roam; track your count in the trophy list. [1][3]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
1. Randy's questline, 'Randy's Wish List', is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS', where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. [1]
2. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is wanted; cars in good condition pay more. [1]
3. He marks some cars for you in fixed spots (often east Vice City, around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach); the rest can be stolen off the street. The list stays open after the story. [1]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide:
1. Play as Jason: Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty'. [1]
2. Go to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City (purple markers) and destroy them in the quest 'Take Out Kitty Litter'. [1]
3. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest 'Spin On This' — finish it to unlock the trophy. [1]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.note: PowerPyx flags this as the only potentially missable trophy; it is still being confirmed whether the Chapter 1 house meditation is required for the trophy itself. [1]
trophies.guide:
1. Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as +2. [1]
2. Track spots under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. [1]
3. MISSABLE — Chapter 1, Jason's house: after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she will meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her, choose 'Accept', and meditate with her. This spot becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. [1][3][6][7]
4. Whether the Chapter 1 house meditation counts toward the 18 is still unclear in the guides — do it anyway to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18. [1]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.note: PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy. [1]
trophies.guide:
1. Play as Jason: Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', when Bret texts you about 'Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)' in Lummox County. [1]
2. Hunt the animals Bret requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' (retrievable at any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). [1]
3. There are 15 Target Decks in total — all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist. Which exact animal pops this trophy is still being confirmed. [1][2]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
1. Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total. [1]
2. The 100% checklist asks for 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past 3. [2]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
1. Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up, then hold R1 on a scannable object. [1]
2. There are more than 100 to find — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags — so any 100 will do. [1]
3. The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK locations scanned. [2]

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
1. Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. [1]
2. Track them under Progress > Challenges; the completed ones show a checkmark. [1]
3. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road — pick the easiest challenges first. [1][2]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
1. Unlock free-roam together first: after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' you can call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). [1]
2. Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner, then escape the red 'heat' zone — the trophy pops once you drive out of it, not when you leave the flashing search area. [1]
3. Easiest escape: a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County), where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. [1]
4. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', since the big bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars. [1]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
1. After the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) and keep a wanted level the whole time — the red/blue flashing level, not the red heat level. [1]
2. Rob 3 shops back-to-back (green robbery icons): loot a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. [1]
3. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop; if it does not, hit a 4th. [1]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.note: PowerPyx's 100% page cites both 557 vehicles in total and 277 base-model vehicles for the checklist. [2]
trophies.guide:
1. Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). [1]
2. Use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive it. [1]
3. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so this trophy comes naturally. [1][2]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
1. Activate Combat Focus while aiming (L3 + R3): time slows and weak spots are highlighted; it drains the purple focus bar. [1]
2. Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Line them up first — gang operations are a good spot — and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. [1]
3. Buff your focus first: eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1 + Triangle) to extend it. Wear body armor from an Ammu-Nation. [1]
4. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by late game you will likely reach level 4. [1]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
1. Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4. [1]
2. Drive through a fence around the airfield and head for the plane; stairs by the boarding bridge lead straight inside (or walk in through the terminal). [1]
3. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The trophy pops once you are far enough away. [1]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
1. Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base. [1]
2. Get in through the gate (or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks. [1]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
1. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs': it unlocks the Snap Gun (to silently lockpick alarmed doors) and jewelry-store robberies, marked with green icons. [1]
2. Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — do not kick the door, which triggers the alarm. [1]
3. In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. [1]
4. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. [1]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
1. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)': it introduces bank vault robberies — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag). [1]
2. After that, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000; you need his earlier quests, including 2 Payday Loans, first). Follow the purple-marked vans to banks. [1]
3. Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape — each vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so leave on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to go unrecognized. [1]
4. There are 8 large bank jobs in total (up to $205,000 each); all 8 are needed for the 100% checklist. [1][2]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
1. The same Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' unlocks this: robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. [1]
2. Or do it earlier: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open. [1]
3. Escape the red 'heat' radius to make it pop. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. [1]

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
1. Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. [1]
2. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. [1]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
1. Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations in total. [1]
2. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them; many are also marked automatically from story progress. [1]
3. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs. All 39 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes with A Long Road. [1][2]

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
1. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach. [1]
2. Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. [1]

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
1. First get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs'. [1]
2. Go to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and steal the blue 'Banshee' on display. [1]
3. Drive it forward, straight through the showroom window. The trophy pops shortly after you drive away — it only works with this blue Banshee, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. [1]

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
1. Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation, marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation. [1]
2. Steal all 3 key valuables inside: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs). [1]
3. The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all 3 in one visit: if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns and you can come back for the rest. [1]

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.note: One other guide describes this as a story unlock rather than a stat goal; PowerPyx gives the maximum-strength method above. [1][6]
trophies.guide:
1. Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength to maximum at the same time. Check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). [1]
2. You can only switch characters after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break'. Work out at fitness clubs (filter them on Map > Activities) — always go together (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner): while one works out, the other trains automatically, doubling progress. [1]
3. You can also work out at home after the story. [1]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide:
1. Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on the notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a demon-face icon appears whenever an action counts. [1]
2. Check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. [1]
3. It happens passively: every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it is still short at the end, the fastest farm is running over civilians and cops with a car — but at Psycho or Irredeemable profile, cops shoot on sight. [1]
4. Profiles run Professional (stealthy, clean escapes), Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable (permanent — avoid it). [1]

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide:
1. No confirmed method yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. [1][7]
2. Do not chase guesses: check back once a guide pins it down. [1]

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide:
1. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and come alone. [1]
2. Look for a blinking car at the roadside. If it is not there, drive away and come back — the spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed. [1]
3. Follow the path from the car into the woods to the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Approach it: the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. [1]

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
1. Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. [1]
2. Do it in a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach. [1]

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
1. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)': it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. [1]
2. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. [1]
3. Deliver $250,000 in total; it counts across robberies, not all at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so it comes naturally with the 100% checklist. [1][2]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
1. Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. [1]
2. The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive items. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 11 tattoo studios and more. [1]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide:
1. Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story garages that do not count). Together they cost $160,000. [1]
2. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver'; a notification installs the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. [1]
3. Buy them through the app. Robberies — especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4 — are the quickest way to earn the money. [1]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
1. The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses'. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. [1]
2. Buy garages first (see Little Boxes): each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles. [1]
3. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage choose 'Respray' and 'Register'. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. [1]
4. Registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep it low. [1]
